The main takeaway from our work is that
policy is necessary but not sufficient to address plastic pollution in the Río de La Plata.

the most relevant policy and institutional measures to mitigate plastic pollution and protect marine species are: (1) the implementation of Extended Producer Responsibility, (2) the implementation of a deposit-refund system, (3) the implementation of effective enforcement of regulations, and (4) the development of a public awareness campaign.
policy and institutions alone cannot mitigate plastic pollution in the ocean; it is necessary to implement effective actions to change the current paradigm of production and consumption of plastics.
